Hello! I'm ARIA, TECHNO Studio's AI assistant. I can answer questions about our services, portfolio, team, and pricing — or help you get in touch. What can I help you with?

The TECHNO team is small, senior, and fully hands-on:

🧠 Rehan Shahzad — COO (AI & Web Dev): Python, Flask, JS, RAG systems, API integrations
🎨 Muhammad Usman — Web Developer & AI Content Creator: branding, AI video, web apps
🔐 Abdul Moiz — Cybersecurity Engineer: pentesting, bug bounty, network security
🎮 Rana Faisal Mustafa — Game & App Developer: Python, Java, C#, C++

No juniors, no account managers — just makers.

Our CEO is Lt Col Muhammad Shahzad Sarwar (Retd) — Group Head of Administration, Security & Corporate Affairs. He brings 25+ years of leadership across the United Nations, Pakistan Army, Air Force, and the Corporate Sector, with a proven track record in HR governance and organisational performance.

Our CEO is Adrian Vale — Founder & Creative Director. He has 15 years of experience leading design and technology teams, has shipped 120+ digital products, and won 9 industry awards. His philosophy: "Great design isn't about adding more — it's about giving every element a reason to exist."
